# Server Maintenance Checklist

*Generated by NOTIXNODE — Schedule and customize for your server*

## Daily (Automated)

- [ ] Automated backups complete (world, plugins, configs, database)
- [ ] Backup verification (test restore monthly)
- [ ] Log rotation (keep last 30 days)
- [ ] Restart server (clears memory leaks, chunk cache)
- [ ] Check console for errors/warnings

## Weekly

- [ ] Review server metrics (TPS, RAM, CPU, player count)
- [ ] Check plugin updates (test on staging first)
- [ ] Review ban/mute/kick logs
- [ ] Check disk space (> 20% free)
- [ ] Verify backup integrity (test restore)
- [ ] Clean up chunk cache / old region files
- [ ] Review economy balances for anomalies

## Monthly

- [ ] Full server backup (including OS if VPS)
- [ ] Update server software (Paper/Spigot/Fabric/Forge)
- [ ] Update all plugins/mods (one at a time, test each)
- [ ] Update Java (if new LTS version)
- [ ] Review and optimize configurations
- [ ] Database maintenance (VACUUM, ANALYZE, index rebuild)
- [ ] Review user permissions (remove inactive staff)
- [ ] Check SSL certificates (if using domain)
- [ ] Review hosting costs/performance

## Quarterly

- [ ] Security audit:
  - [ ] Review open ports
  - [ ] Check for default passwords
  - [ ] Verify SSH key authentication only
  - [ ] Review firewall rules
  - [ ] Check for plugin vulnerabilities
- [ ] World border review (expand if needed)
- [ ] Performance profiling (Spark, Timings)
- [ ] Hardware health check (SMART, temps, RAM test)
- [ ] Disaster recovery drill (full restore test)
- [ ] Staff policy review

## Semi-Annually

- [ ] Major version upgrade planning
- [ ] Plugin audit (remove unused, replace abandoned)
- [ ] Capacity planning (player growth trends)
- [ ] Backup strategy review (off-site, retention)
- [ ] Documentation update

## Annually

- [ ] Hardware replacement cycle review
- [ ] Hosting provider evaluation
- [ ] Full architecture review
- [ ] Emergency contact verification
- [ ] License renewals (domain, SSL, paid plugins)

## Emergency Procedures

- [ ] Crash recovery plan documented
- [ ] Rollback procedure tested
- [ ] DDoS mitigation plan
- [ ] Data breach response plan
- [ ] Staff escalation contacts current

---

*Customize intervals based on your server size and activity*
